description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI class within the Recruitment API module of OrangeHRM. It sets up test cases, mocks dependencies, and verifies API behaviors such as getAll, getOne, create, delete, and update operations, primarily focusing on ensuring that unimplemented methods throw exceptions and that create and getOne methods perform as expected.
